name: Twitter/X sentiment extreme-negative + oversold — social capitulation reversion (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why X sentiment leads a bottom): crypto Twitter/X is where retail conviction forms and breaks in real time. A deeply negative Grok-scored sentiment reading marks a social capitulation — the crowd is loudly bearish, which historically coincides with washed-out, over-sold positioning that mean-reverts at the swing horizon. The sentiment print (availability == observation time, no look-ahead) captures the mood extreme slightly before price finishes bottoming. RSI oversold is the price confirmation so we fade a genuine washout. Exit when sentiment crosses back up through zero (mood normalizes). DISCONFIRMER 1: if RSI-oversold alone matches the deflated Sharpe, sentiment adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: sentiment can stay negative through a whole downtrend (the crowd is right) — the tight stop and short hold guard the knife; a wide fitted stop means it is trend, not reversion. Requires XAI_API_KEY; tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: twitter_sentiment is deeply NEGATIVE (X crowd panic) while RSI is oversold — a social washout to fade.
